1.explanation_en: 聚集 means “gather”; the attached aspect marker 了 presents the gathering as a completed event.

1.meaning_en: the more they talked, the happier they became
1.explanation_en: The paired 越…越… construction links two increasing states: as the amount of talking increases, happiness increases.
结为 introduces a resulting status, and 兄弟 names that status: the three men form a brotherhood.
杀 means “kill”; the attached 了 marks the killing as completed. The person killed remains outside the unit.
打 means “fight”; the attached 了 marks the action as completed. The duration phrase 一会儿 remains separate.
The positive-negative pattern 有没有 asks whether possession holds; the thing asked about, 官职, remains separate.
The paired 又…又… construction links two states, presenting them together: 气 means “angry” here, and 不满 means “dissatisfied.”
活 means “live”; 下来 acts as a result complement, conveying continuing into the resulting state of being alive.
留 means “leave,” 下 marks the result of something remaining behind, and the attached 了 presents that result as completed. 悬念 remains separate.
